primitive.relation: nat equality: the X118/X120 edge counts and X120's non-edge count already had the bodies of edges_between / nonedges_between (conversion); X223 associates && the other way (eq_card and andbA). Ordered pairs over arbitrary, possibly overlapping sets: no disjointness is added. The cross-edge and complement readings are separate lemmas guarded by disjointness.

ordered-edge-pairs.note: #|[set p : G * G | [&& p.1 \in A, p.2 \in B & p.1 -- p.2]]| (X223: ((p.1 \in A) && (p.2 \in B)) && (p.1 -- p.2), equal by andbA); arbitrary, possibly overlapping A and B

ordered-nonedge-pairs.note: #|[set p : G * G | [&& p.1 \in A, p.2 \in B & ~~ (p.1 -- p.2)]]|, diagonal pairs of A :&: B included; agrees with the complement-edge count on disjoint sets (nonedges_between_compl)
